description: This file defines password generation logic, including configuration types, default settings, character sets, and functions for generating cryptographically secure passwords with specific constraints.

methods.name: getSecureRandomInt
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure random integer in the range [0, max).

methods.name: removeAmbiguous
methods.description: Removes ambiguous characters from a given charset.

methods.name: getRandomChar
methods.description: Selects a random character from a given charset.

methods.name: generatePassword
methods.description: Generates a password based on provided configuration, ensuring inclusion of minimum character types and avoiding ambiguous characters if specified.
